summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug semaglutide in young people with obesity, prediabetes or early type 2 diabetes, and liver fat buildup. Researchers want to learn how the treatment affects blood sugar control and fat levels in the liver. Participants are divided into groups to receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug. This is a Phase 2 study with 60 participants sponsored by Yale University.
